Job Summary

InnoVet Health is an innovative and rapidly growing small business providing health IT services to U.S. federal government agencies, particularly the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). InnoVet is looking to hire a Senior Systems Engineer to support the modernization of VA’s Veterans and Family Member Programs (VFMP). This individual will lead the analysis and design of current-state and future-state data architecture supporting legacy-system migration, payer EDI integration, enterprise reporting, and business-rule decisions. The role will work closely with VFMP stakeholders, data engineers, analysts, system owners, OIT teams, and external partners to translate complex healthcare payer requirements into scalable data models, integration designs, mappings, and implementation-ready technical artifacts.

This is a full-time, remote position with competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and significant growth potential. You will have the chance to make a meaningful impact while enjoying the flexibility of working from home.

If you're ready to take your career to the next level in the federal sector, we'd love to hear from you. Please send your resume and interest to hr@innovethealth.com.

Responsibilities:

Support the development of logical and physical data models, data architecture diagrams, and system context diagrams for VFMP's data migration and integration efforts.
Ensure technology solutions are implemented reliably, integrated effectively, and aligned with performance and security requirements.
Support the translation of business requirements into functional and technical requirements.
Identify data-quality issues, integration dependencies, architectural risks, defects, and unresolved technical decisions; support root-cause analysis, escalation, and resolution.
Develop SQL queries to profile source data, validate mappings and transformations, reconcile migrated data, and assess downstream data integrity.
Support end-to-end testing, UAT, defect resolution, implementation-readiness reviews, and go/no-go decisions by validating solutions against approved data, interface, and technical requirements.
Provide technical direction to data engineers and analysts while maintaining consistency across data models, interfaces, integration components, and implementation artifacts.
Analyze metrics to obtain insight into program performance, making recommendations for improvement
Support project reviews, including integrated baseline reviews, milestone reviews, and go / no-go decisions

Qualifications:

Demonstrated experience in system architecture, data architecture, integration design, or enterprise data engineering.
Experience translating business requirements into data, functional, interface, and technical requirements.
Experience with healthcare payer data or EDI transactions, including one or more of the following domains: claims, encounters, eligibility, enrollment, providers, remittance, prior authorization, or pharmacy.
Experience analyzing legacy systems and designing target-state data structures for integration, consolidation, or migration.
Experience providing technical direction and coordinating work across business stakeholders, architects, engineers, analysts, developers, and external partners.
8+ years of experience in system architecture, design, integration, and technical management
Experience supporting federal programs
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
Must be U.S. citizen and eligible for VA clearance.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with healthcare payer EDI and X12 and/or NCPDP standards.
Experience developing payer companion guides, EDI mappings, compliance rules, or trading-partner specifications.
Knowledge of healthcare claims, eligibility, remittance, claim-status, prior-authorization, or pharmacy transactions.
Experience supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs or another federal agency.
Experience supporting large-scale modernization, legacy-system migration, automation, or data integration.
